122 /* per line : 4 x 4 bytes
123 * addressing a byte column : row = integer (address / 4x 4 bytes)
124 * column : remainder = address - integer (address / 4x 4 bytes)
125 * if remainder < 4
126 * column : remainder / 4
127 * if remainder < 8
128 * column : (remainder / 8) + 1
129 * if remainder < 16
130 * column : (remainder / 16) + 2
131 * address - integer (address / 4x 4 bytes) / (4 + 1)
132*/

851void
852ZRawVisuMain::setSelectionBackGround(QVariant& pBackground,ssize_t pOffset,size_t pSize,bool pScrollTo) {
853 VisuLineCol wVLC;
854 wVLC.compute(pOffset);
855 int wStartLine = wVLC.line;
856 int wStartColumn = wVLC.col;
857
858 int wCurLine = wStartLine;
859 int wCurCol = wStartColumn;
860 int wCount=0;
861 int wColLimit = Width + 3 ;
862
863 /* highlight process */
864 QStandardItem* wFirstItem=VisuTBv->ItemModel->item(wCurLine,wCurCol);
865 if (wFirstItem==nullptr) {
866 wCurCol++;
867 if (wCurCol >= wColLimit ) {
868 wCurCol = 0;
869 wCurLine ++;
870 }
871 wFirstItem = VisuTBv->ItemModel->item(wCurLine,wCurCol);
872 }
873 wFirstItem->setData(pBackground, Qt::BackgroundRole);
874 while (wCount < pSize) {
875
876 QStandardItem* wItem=VisuTBv->ItemModel->item(wCurLine,wCurCol);
877 if (wItem!=nullptr) {
878 wItem->setData(pBackground, Qt::BackgroundRole);
879 wCount++;
880 }
881 wCurCol++;
882 if (wCurCol >= wColLimit ) {
883 wCurCol = 0;
884 wCurLine ++;
885 }
886 }// while true
887
888 if (pScrollTo) {
889 QModelIndex wIdx=VisuTBv->ItemModel->indexFromItem(wFirstItem);
890 VisuTBv->scrollTo(wIdx);
891 }
892
893} // ZRawVisuMain::setSelectionBackGround
894
895
896bool ZRawVisuMain::searchHexa(bool pReverse) {
897
898 utf8VaryingString wSearchStr=searchLEd->text().toUtf8().data();
899
900 /* must be hexa digit*/
901 SearchContent.allocateBZero(wSearchStr.strlen() / 2);
902
903 utf8_t* wChar = wSearchStr.Data;
904 uint8_t wHexaValue=0;
905 long wOffset=0;
906 while (*wChar) {
907 if (getHexaDigits(wChar,wHexaValue)) {
908 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Invalid hexadecimal string",Severity_Error,nullptr,&wSearchStr,"Invalid hexadecimal string. Cannot convert.");
909 return false;
910 }
911 SearchContent[wOffset++]=wHexaValue;
912 }// while
913
914 if (pReverse) {
915 if (SearchOffset==0) {
916 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Search",Severity_Error,nullptr,&wSearchStr,"Already at beginning.");
917 return false;
918 }
919 SearchOffset -= SearchContent.Size ;
920 }
921
922 if ((FormerSearchOffset >= 0 )&&(FormerSearchSize > 0))
923 setSelectionBackGround(DefaultBackGround,FormerSearchOffset,FormerSearchSize,false);
924 if (SearchOffset < 0)
925 SearchOffset=0;
926
927 if (pReverse)
928 SearchOffset=RawData.breverseSearch(SearchContent,SearchOffset);
929 else
930 SearchOffset=RawData.bsearch(SearchContent,SearchOffset);
931
932 FormerSearchOffset=SearchOffset;
933 FormerSearchSize=SearchContent.Size;
934
935 if (SearchOffset < 0) {
936 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Search",Severity_Error,nullptr,&wSearchStr,"Value not found.");
937 return false;
938 }
939
940 setSelectionBackGround(SelectedBackGround,SearchOffset,SearchContent.Size,true);
941
942 SearchOffset += SearchContent.Size;
943
944 return true;
945// model.setData(model.index(0, 0), QVariant(QBrush(Qt::red)), Qt::BackgroundRole);
946}//ZRawVisuMain::searchHexa
947
948bool ZRawVisuMain::searchAscii(bool pCaseRegardless, bool pReverse) {
949 utf8VaryingString wSearchStr=searchLEd->text().toUtf8().data();
950 if (pReverse) {
951 if (SearchOffset==0) {
952 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Search",Severity_Error,nullptr,&wSearchStr,"Already at beginning.");
953 return false;
954 }
955 SearchOffset -= wSearchStr.strlen();
956 }
957
958 /* must be hexa digit*/
959 size_t wLength=wSearchStr.strlen();
960 SearchContent.allocateBZero( wLength+ 1);
961
962 if ((FormerSearchOffset >= 0 )&&(FormerSearchSize > 0))
963 setSelectionBackGround(DefaultBackGround,FormerSearchOffset,FormerSearchSize);
964 if (SearchOffset < 0)
965 SearchOffset=0;
966
967 if (pCaseRegardless) {
968 if (pReverse)
969 SearchOffset=RawData.breverseSearchCaseRegardless(wSearchStr.Data,wLength,SearchOffset);
970 else
971 SearchOffset=RawData.bsearchCaseRegardless(wSearchStr.Data,wLength,SearchOffset);
972 }
973 else {
974 if (pReverse)
975 SearchOffset=RawData.breverseSearch(wSearchStr.Data,wLength,SearchOffset);
976 else
977 SearchOffset=RawData.bsearch(wSearchStr.Data,wLength,SearchOffset);
978 }
979
980 FormerSearchOffset=SearchOffset;
981 FormerSearchSize=SearchContent.Size;
982
983 if (SearchOffset < 0) {
984 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Search",Severity_Error,nullptr,&wSearchStr,"Value not found.");
985 return false;
986 }
987
988 setSelectionBackGround(SelectedBackGround,SearchOffset,SearchContent.Size);
989
990 SearchOffset += SearchContent.Size;
991
992 return true;
993}//ZRawVisuMain::searchAscii

1316 "Choose another one <Other>\n"
1317 "Quit without doing anything <Quit>\n",
1318 RawMasterFile->getURIContent().toString());
1319 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
1320 return;
1321 if (wRet==QDialog::Accepted) {
1322 wZMF = RawMasterFile;
1323 if (!wZMF->isOpen()) {
1324 wSt=wZMF->zopen(ZRF_Read_Only);
1325 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
1326 utf8VaryingString wExcp = ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage().toString();
1327 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("ZMF data export",Severity_Error,
1328 nullptr,&wExcp,"Error while opening master file %s",wZMF->getURIContent().toString());
1329 return;
1330 }
1331 wHasBeenOpened=true;
1332 }
1333 break;
1334 }// QDialog::Accepted)
1335 /* ZEDLG_Third : let's go to file selection */
1336 //if (wRet==QDialog::ZEDLG_Third) {
1337 //} // ZEDLG_Third
1338 } //if (RawMasterFile!=nullptr)
1339
1340 QString wFileName = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(this, tr("Raw master file"),
1341 wDir.toCChar(),
1342 "master files (*.zmf);;All (*.*)");
1343 if (wFileName.isEmpty())
1344 return;
1345 uriString wZMFURI= wFileName.toUtf8().data();
1346 if (!wZMFURI.exists())
1347 return;
1348 wZMF = new ZRawMasterFile;
1349 wHasBeenCreated=true;
1350 wSt=wZMF->zopen(wZMFURI,ZRF_Read_Only);
1351 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
1352 utf8VaryingString wExcp = ZException.last().formatFullUserMessage().toString();
1353 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("ZMF data export",Severity_Error,
1354 nullptr,&wExcp,"Error while opening master file %s",wZMFURI.toString());
1355 return;
1356 }
1357 wHasBeenOpened=true;
1358 break;
1359 } // while true
1360
1361 wSt=exportZMF(this,wZMF, nullptr);
1362 if (wHasBeenOpened)
1363 wZMF->zclose();
1364 if (wHasBeenCreated)
1365 delete wZMF;
1366 return;
1367 }//ZMFExportQAc
1368
1369 if (pAction==ZMFImportQAc) {
1370 openGenLogWin();
1371 GenlogWin->setWindowTitle("Import process log");
1372 GenlogWin->show();
1373
1374 wSt=importZMF(this, &ErrorLog);
1375/*
1376 if (wHasBeenOpened)
1377 wZMF->zclose();
1378 if (wHasBeenCreated)
1379 delete wZMF;
1380*/
1381 return;
1382 }//ZMFImportQAc
1383
1384 if (pAction==ZMFBackupQAc) {
1385 ZBackupDLg wBckDLg(this);
1386
1387 int wRet=wBckDLg.exec();
1388
1389 } //ZMFBackupQAc
1390
1391 if (pAction==ZMFRestoreQAc) {
1392 ZRestoreDLg RestoreDLg(this);
1393
1394 int wRet=RestoreDLg.exec();
1395
1396 } //ZMFRestoreQAc
1397
1398 if (pAction==ZMFClearQAc) {
1399 clearZMF(this,&ErrorLog);
1400 } //ZMFClearQAc
1401
1402
1403 if (pAction==ZRFSurfaceScanQAc) {
1404 surfaceScanZRF();
1405 return;
1406 }
1407 if (pAction==surfaceScanRawQAc)
1408 {
1409 displayRawSurfaceScan(URICurrent);
1410 return;
1411 }
1412
1413 if (pAction==QuitQAc)
1414 {
1415 // actionClose();
1416 close();
1417// this->deleteLater();
1418// QApplication::quit();
1419 return;
1420 }
1421
1422
1423 /* ZMFMEn */
1424
1425 if (pAction==runRepairQAc) {
1426 repairIndexes(testRunQAc->isChecked(), rebuilAllQAc->isChecked());
1427 return;
1428 }
1429
1430 if (pAction==MCBReportQAc) {
1431 reportMCB();
1432 return;
1433 }
1434
1435 return;
1436
1437}//actionMenuEvent

2129void
2130ZRawVisuMain::displayICBs()
2131{
2132 /* HCB and MCB are deserialized here just to test if there is enough space.
2133 * these values are computed again within DisplayMain::--- to access real values
2134 */
2135 if (!testRequestedSize(URICurrent,RawData,sizeof(ZHeaderControlBlock_Export)+sizeof(ZFCB_Export)+sizeof(ZMCB_Export)))
2136 return ;
2137
2138 const unsigned char* wPtr = RawData.Data;
2139 ZHeaderControlBlock_Export wZHCBe;
2140 memmove(&wZHCBe,RawData.Data,sizeof(ZHeaderControlBlock_Export));
2141 if (wZHCBe.StartSign!=cst_ZBLOCKSTART) {
2142 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Invalid Header",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,"Header Control Block appears to be corrupted.");
2143 return;
2144 }
2145
2146 wZHCBe.deserialize();
2147
2148 /* Index file : ICB is the only content of reserved block */
2149 if (wZHCBe.FileType==ZFT_ZIndexFile) {
2150 if (!testRequestedSize(URICurrent,RawData,sizeof(ZHeaderControlBlock_Export)+sizeof(ZFCB_Export)+sizeof(ZICB_Export)))
2151 return;
2152 if (!entityWnd)
2153 entityWnd=new DisplayMain(&URICurrent,this);
2154 const unsigned char* wPtrIn=RawData.Data + wZHCBe.OffsetReserved;
2155 size_t wDisplayOffset = sizeof(ZHeaderControlBlock_Export) + wZHCBe.OffsetReserved ;
2156 int wRow=0;
2157
2158 entityWnd->setWindowTitle(QObject::tr("Index File ICB","DisplayMain"));
2159 entityWnd->displaySingleICBValues(wPtrIn,wDisplayOffset,wRow);
2160
2161 entityWnd->show();
2162 return;
2163 }
2164 /* master file : must get ZMasterControlBlock first to jump to ICBs list */
2165
2166 ZMCB_Export wZMCBe;
2167 memmove(&wZMCBe,wPtr+wZHCBe.OffsetReserved,sizeof(ZMCB_Export));
2168
2169 wZMCBe.deserialize();
2170
2171 if (!wZMCBe.isValid()) {
2172 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Invalid MCB",Severity_Error,nullptr,nullptr,"Master Control Block (Reserved space) appears to be corrupted.");
2173 return;
2174 }
2175
2176 if (!testRequestedSize(URICurrent,RawData,sizeof(ZHeaderControlBlock_Export)+sizeof(ZFCB_Export)+sizeof(ZMCB_Export)+wZMCBe.ICBOffset + wZMCBe.ICBSize))
2177 return;
2178 if (!entityWnd)
2179 entityWnd=new DisplayMain(&URICurrent,this);
2180
2181 entityWnd->displayICBs(RawData);
2182
2183 return;
2184}

2186void
2187ZRawVisuMain::displayZBAT()
2188{
2189 if (!testRequestedSize(URICurrent,RawData,sizeof(ZHeaderControlBlock_Export)+sizeof(ZFCB_Export)+sizeof(ZMCB_Export)))
2190 return ;
2191
2192 unsigned char* wPtr=RawData.Data;
2193 ZHeaderControlBlock_Export* wHe = (ZHeaderControlBlock_Export*)RawData.Data;
2194 if (wHe->isNotReversed())
2195 {
2196 _ABORT_
2197 }
2198 zaddress_type wOffset= reverseByteOrder_Conditional<zaddress_type>(wHe->OffsetFCB);
2199 wPtr += wOffset;
2200 ZFCB_Export* wFCBe = (ZFCB_Export*)(wPtr);
2201 if (wFCBe->isNotReversed())
2202 {
2203 _ABORT_
2204 }
2205 wOffset= reverseByteOrder_Conditional<size_t>(wFCBe->ZBAT_DataOffset);
2206 wPtr += wOffset;
2207
2208 displayPool(wPtr,wOffset,"ZBAT Block Access Table");
2209 return;
2210}

2212void
2213ZRawVisuMain::displayPool(const unsigned char* pPtr,zaddress_type pOffset,const char* pTitle)
2214{
2215 ZAExport* wZAEe=(ZAExport*) pPtr;
2216 utf8VaryingString wOut;
2217 utf8VaryingString wStr;
2218 utf8VaryingString wEndianStatus;
2219 wStr.sprintf("%08X",wZAEe->StartSign);
2220 wOut.sprintf (
2221 "offset absolute %ld 0x%X relative to FCB %ld 0x%X \n"
2222 "Field name Raw value Deserialized Complement/Comment\n"
2223 "StartSign %08X %08X %s\n"
2224 "EndianCheck %25d %25d %s\n"
2225 "AllocatedSize %25ld %25ld Size in bytes of allocated space\n"
2226 "CurrentSize %25ld %25ld Current data size in bytes (data not exported)\n"
2227 "DataSize %25ld %25ld ZArray content export size\n"
2228 "FullSize %25ld %25ld Total exported size in bytes including this header\n"
2229 "AllocatedElements %25ld %25ld Number of allocated elements\n"
2230 "ExtentQuota %25ld %25ld Extension quota : number of elements ZArray will be increased each time\n"
2231 "InitialAllocation %25ld %25ld Number of elements intially allocated during creation\n"
2232 "NbElements %25ld %25ld Number of current elements\n",
2233 size_t(pPtr-RawData.Data),size_t(pPtr-RawData.Data),pOffset,pOffset,
2234 wZAEe->StartSign,wZAEe->StartSign,wZAEe->StartSign==cst_ZMSTART?"cst_ZMSTART":"Wrong",
2235 wZAEe->EndianCheck,reverseByteOrder_Conditional<uint16_t>(wZAEe->EndianCheck),wZAEe->isReversed()?"Serialized":"NOT Serialized",
2236 wZAEe->AllocatedSize,reverseByteOrder_Conditional (wZAEe->AllocatedSize),
2237 wZAEe->CurrentSize,reverseByteOrder_Conditional (wZAEe->CurrentSize),
2238 wZAEe->DataSize,reverseByteOrder_Conditional (wZAEe->DataSize),
2239 wZAEe->FullSize,reverseByteOrder_Conditional (wZAEe->FullSize),
2240 wZAEe->AllocatedElements,reverseByteOrder_Conditional (wZAEe->AllocatedElements),
2241 wZAEe->ExtentQuota,reverseByteOrder_Conditional (wZAEe->ExtentQuota),
2242 wZAEe->InitialAllocation,reverseByteOrder_Conditional (wZAEe->InitialAllocation),
2243 wZAEe->NbElements,reverseByteOrder_Conditional (wZAEe->NbElements));
2244
2245
2246// textEditMWn* wTEx=openGenLogWin();
2247 textEditMWn* wTEx=GenlogWin = new textEditMWn(this);
2248 wTEx->setText(wOut,pTitle);
2249
2250 int wNbElt = int(reverseByteOrder_Conditional<ssize_t> (wZAEe->NbElements));
2251 if (wNbElt==0)
2252 {
2253 wOut.sprintf("\n\n No element in Pool.\n");
2254 wTEx->appendText(wOut);
2255 wTEx->show();
2256 return;
2257 }
2258 if (wNbElt > cst_maxraisonablevalue ) {
2259 wOut.sprintf("\n\n value <%d> is not a reasonable value.\n"
2260 " Pool might be corrupted.\n"
2261 " Limiting number elements to 10.\n",wNbElt);
2262 wNbElt = 10;
2263 }
2264
2265 const unsigned char* wPtr = pPtr+sizeof(ZAExport);
2266 ZBlockDescriptor_Export wBDe;
2267 wOut=
2268 " \n\n"
2269 "------+-------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------------+\n"
2270 " Rank | StartSign | EndianCheck | BlockId | State | Address (deserialized) | Block size |\n"
2271 " | hexa state |Value Meaning |Val Meaning |Val Meaning | Decimal Hexa | Raw (Hexa) deserialized|\n"
2272 "------+-------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------------+";
2273 wTEx->appendText(wOut);
2274 int wi=0;
2275 while (wi < wNbElt)
2276 {
2277 wBDe.setFromPtr(wPtr);
2278
2279 wOut.sprintf(
2280 "%5ld |%08X %10s|%4X %10s|%2X %12s|%2X %12s|%20lld 0x%10llX|%16llX %20lld|",
2281 wi,
2282 wBDe.StartSign ,wBDe.StartSign==cst_ZFILEBLOCKSTART?"Valid":"Invalid",
2283 wBDe.EndianCheck ,wBDe.isReversed()?"Reversed":"Not Rever.",
2284 wBDe.BlockId,decode_ZBID(wBDe.BlockId), // BlockId is uint8_t and do not need to be deserialized
2285 wBDe.State , decode_ZBS(wBDe.State), // State is uint8_t and does not need to be deserialized
2286 reverseByteOrder_Conditional<zaddress_type>(wBDe.Address),reverseByteOrder_Conditional<zaddress_type>(wBDe.Address),
2287 wBDe.BlockSize,reverseByteOrder_Conditional<zsize_type>(wBDe.BlockSize)
2288 );
2289 wTEx->appendText(wOut);
2290 wi++;
2291 }
2292
2293 wTEx->appendText("------+-------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------------+\n");
2294 wTEx->show();
2295
2296}// displayPool

2351bool
2352ZRawVisuMain::testRequestedSize(const uriString& pURI, ZDataBuffer& pRawData,size_t pRequestedSize){
2353 if (pRawData.Size < pRequestedSize)
2354 {
2355 int wRet=ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2B("displayICBs",Severity_Warning,"Quit","Load",
2356 nullptr,nullptr,
2357 "Not enough data loaded. Requested minimum size is <%ld> bytes.\n"
2358 "Only <%ld> Bytes have been loaded.\n\n"
2359 "Load / reload file content <Reload>\n"
2360 "Quit <Quit>",pRequestedSize);
2361
2362 if (wRet==ZEDLG_Rejected)
2363 return false;
2364 // case ZEDLG_Accepted:
2365 if (pURI.getFileSize()>100000000)
2366 {
2367 ZExceptionDLg::message("ZRawVisuMain::displayMCB",ZS_INVSIZE,Severity_Error,
2368 "Cannot load content of file <%s> size <%lld> exceeds memory capacity",
2369 pURI.toString(),
2370 pURI.getFileSize());
2371 return false;
2372 }
2373 if (pURI.getFileSize()<(pRequestedSize+1))
2374 {
2375 ZExceptionDLg::message("ZRawVisuMain::displayMCB",ZS_INVSIZE,Severity_Error,
2376 "file <%s> has size <%lld> that does not allow to store requested header data.",
2377 pURI.toString(),
2378 pURI.getFileSize());
2379 return false;
2380 }
2381 if (pURI.loadContent(pRawData)!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2382 return false;
2383 }//if (RawData.Size < sizeof(ZHeaderControlBlock_Export)+sizeof(ZFCB_Export)+sizeof(ZSMCBOwnData_Export))
2384 return true;
2385}

2520void
2521ZRawVisuMain::displayOneLine(int pRow,unsigned char* &pPtr,unsigned char* pPtrEnd, size_t pFileOffset, bool pUseHexa) {
2522
2523 utf8VaryingString wLineHexa,wLineAscii,wlineOffset;
2524
2525// wlineOffset.sprintf("%6d-0x%6X",FileOffset,FileOffset);
2526
2527 if (pUseHexa)
2528 wlineOffset.sprintf("0x%6X",pFileOffset);
2529 else
2530 wlineOffset.sprintf("%6ld",pFileOffset);
2531
2532 wLineAscii.allocateUnitsBZero(Width+1);
2533
2534 int wCol=0;
2535 int wD=0;
2536 for (int wi=0;(wi < Width) && (pPtr < pPtrEnd);wi++) {
2537 wLineHexa.sprintf("%02X",*pPtr);
2538 VisuTBv->ItemModel->setItem(pRow,wCol,new QStandardItem(wLineHexa.toCChar()));
2539 if ((*pPtr>31)&&(*pPtr<127))
2540 wLineAscii.Data[wi]=*pPtr;
2541 else
2542 wLineAscii.Data[wi] = '.' ;
2543
2544 wCol++;
2545 wD++;
2546 if (wD==4) {
2547 wD=0;
2548 wCol++;
2549 }
2550 pPtr++;
2551 }// for
2552 VisuTBv->ItemModel->setVerticalHeaderItem (pRow,new QStandardItem(wlineOffset.toCChar()));
2553
2554 // VisuTBv->setItem(wCurLine,0,new QTableWidgetItem(wLineHexa.toCChar()));
2555 VisuTBv->ItemModel->setItem(pRow,20,new QStandardItem(wLineAscii.toCChar()));
2556
2557 if (DefaultBackGround.isValid())
2558 return;
2559 DefaultBackGround = VisuTBv->ItemModel->item(0,0)->data(Qt::BackgroundRole);
2560
2561} // displayOneLine

2563
2564ZStatus
2565ZRawVisuMain::displayWidgetBlock(ZDataBuffer& pData, size_t& pFileOffset) {
2566
2567 ProgressPGb->setRange(0,pData.Size);
2568 ProgressPGb->setValue(0);
2569 ProgressPGb->setVisible(true);
2570
2571 /* how many lines within pData block */
2572
2573 int wLines=pData.Size / Width;
2574
2575 int wRem=pData.Size - ( wLines * Width);
2576
2577 if (wRem > 0)
2578 wLines++;
2579
2580 int wBaseLine=VisuTBv->ItemModel->rowCount();
2581
2582 VisuTBv->ItemModel->setRowCount(VisuTBv->ItemModel->rowCount()+wLines);
2583
2584 // utf8VaryingString wLineHexa,wLineAscii,wlineOffset;
2585
2586 /* cut by chunk of Width bytes */
2587 long wRemain=pData.Size;
2588 unsigned char* wPtr = pData.Data;
2589 unsigned char* wPtrEnd = pData.Data+pData.Size;
2590
2591 int wTick = 0;
2592 long wProgress=0;
2593 int wCurLine=wBaseLine;
2594 while ((wPtr < wPtrEnd)&&(wRemain >= Width)) {
2595
2596 displayOneLine(wCurLine,wPtr,wPtrEnd,pFileOffset,UseHexa);
2597
2598 pFileOffset += Width;
2599 wRemain -= Width;
2600 wProgress += Width;
2601 wCurLine++;
2602 if (wTick++ > 10) {
2603 wTick=0;
2604 ProgressPGb->setValue(wProgress);
2605 }
2606 }//while ((wPtr < wPtrEnd)&&(wRemain >= Width))
2607
2608 if (wRemain > 0) {
2609 displayOneLine(wCurLine,wPtr,wPtrEnd,pFileOffset,UseHexa);
2610 pFileOffset += wRemain;
2611 }
2612
2613
2614 for (int wi=0;wi < VisuTBv->ItemModel->rowCount();wi++)
2615 VisuTBv->resizeRowToContents(wi);
2616 for (int wi=0;wi < VisuTBv->ItemModel->columnCount();wi++)
2617 VisuTBv->resizeColumnToContents(wi);
2618
2619 VisuTBv->setColumnWidth(4,4);
2620 VisuTBv->setColumnWidth(9,4);
2621 VisuTBv->setColumnWidth(16,4);
2622
2623 ProgressPGb->setValue(pData.Size);
2624 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2625}//displayBlock

2649ZStatus
2650ZRawVisuMain::displayListZRFNextRecord(size_t pWidth)
2651{
2652 ZStatus wSt;
2653 if (RecordNumber==0)
2654 BackwardBTn->setVisible(false);
2655 else
2656 BackwardBTn->setVisible(true);
2657
2658 // get first block of the file
2659 wSt=RandomFile->_getNext(Block,RecordNumber,Address); // next logical block
2660 if (wSt==ZS_EOF)
2661 {
2662 ForwardBTn->setVisible(false);
2663 return ZS_EOF;
2664 }
2665 ForwardBTn->setVisible(true);
2666 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2667 {
2668 ZExceptionDLg::displayLast("Read file");
2669// QMessageBox::critical(this,tr("Random File error"),ZException.formatFullUserMessage().toCChar());
2670 return wSt;
2671 }
2672
2673
2674 displayBlockData();
2675
2676 RawData=Block.Content;
2677
2678 removeAllRows();
2679
2680 displayWidgetBlock(RawData,(size_t&)FileOffset);
2681
2682 ForwardBTn->setVisible(true);
2683 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2684}//displayListZRFNextRecord

2686ZStatus
2687ZRawVisuMain::displayListZRFPreviousRecord(size_t pWidth)
2688{
2689 ZStatus wSt;
2690
2691 RecordNumber--;
2692 if (RecordNumber==0)
2693 BackwardBTn->setVisible(false);
2694
2695 // get first block of the file
2696 wSt=RandomFile->_getByRank(Block,RecordNumber,Address); // get first block of the file
2697 if (wSt==ZS_EOF)
2698 {
2699 ForwardBTn->setVisible(false);
2700 return ZS_EOF;
2701 }
2702
2703 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS)
2704 {
2705 QMessageBox::critical(this,tr("Random File error"),ZException.formatFullUserMessage().toCChar());
2706 return wSt;
2707 }
2708
2709 displayBlockData();
2710
2711 if (RandomFile->getFileDescriptor().ZBAT.count() > 1)
2712 ForwardBTn->setVisible(true);
2713 RawData=Block.Content;
2714
2715 displayWidgetBlock(RawData,(size_t&)FileOffset);
2716
2717
2718 return ZS_SUCCESS;
2719}//displayListZRFPreviousRecord

2721ZStatus
2722ZRawVisuMain::displayListZRFFirstRecord(size_t pWidth)
2723{
2724 ZStatus wSt;
2725
2726 BackwardBTn->setVisible(false);
2727
2728 FileOffset=0;
2729 RecordNumber = 0L;
2730 wSt=RandomFile->_getByRank(Block,RecordNumber,Address); // get first block of the file
2731 if (wSt==ZS_EOF)
2732 {
2733 ForwardBTn->setVisible(false);
2734 return ZS_EOF;
2735 }

2761void
2762ZRawVisuMain::backward()
2763{
2764 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
2765
2766 switch (VisuType)
2767 {
2768 case ZCVM_RandomFile:
2769 wSt = displayListZRFNextRecord(Width);
2770 return;
2771 case ZCVM_Raw:
2772 if (FileOffset == 0 ) {
2773 BackwardBTn->setVisible(false);
2774 return ;
2775 }
2776 FileOffset -= PayLoad;
2777 FileOffset -= PayLoad;
2778 if (FileOffset < 0 )
2779 FileOffset = 0;
2780
2781 if ((FileOffset+PayLoad) > FileSize)
2782 ForwardBTn->setVisible(false);
2783 else
2784 ForwardBTn->setVisible(true);
2785
2786 wSt=displayRawFromOffset(PayLoad);
2787 return ;
2788 case ZCVM_MasterFile:
2789 wSt = displayListZRFNextRecord(Width);
2790 return;
2791 }
2792
2793
2794 if (RandomFile)
2795 {
2796 displayListZRFPreviousRecord(Width);
2797 return;
2798 }
2799
2800 FileOffset=lseek(Fd,(__off_t)-BlockSize,SEEK_CUR);
2801 if (FileOffset <= 0)
2802 {
2803 BackwardBTn->setVisible(false);
2804 }
2805 displayFdNextRawBlock(BlockSize,Width);
2806}

2982
2983struct ScanBlockCount {
2984 int TotalBlocks = 0;
2985 int UsedBlocks = 0;
2986 int FreeBlocks = 0;
2987 int DeletedBlocks = 0;
2988 int ErroredBlocks = 0;
2989 int Holes = 0;
2990 int HoleVolume = 0;
2991 int UsedVolume = 0;
2992 int FreeVolume = 0;
2993 int DeletedVolume = 0;
2994 int ErroredVolume = 0;
2995};
2996
2997
2998utf8VaryingString
2999displaytScanBlock(ScanBlock& pSB,ScanBlockCount& pSBCount) {
3000 int wH=0;
3001 utf8VaryingString wOut,wBlockSize,wHoleSize,wComment;
3002 pSBCount.TotalBlocks ++;
3003 wHoleSize=" ";
3004
3005 switch (pSB.BlockHeader.State) {
3006 case ZBS_Used:
3007 pSBCount.UsedBlocks ++;
3008 pSBCount.UsedVolume += pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize;
3009 wBlockSize.sprintf("%15ld",pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3010 wH = int (pSB.End - pSB.Begin - pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3011 if (wH > 0) {
3012 wHoleSize.sprintf("%ld",wH);
3013 pSBCount.Holes ++;
3014 pSBCount.HoleVolume += wH;
3015 }
3016 else if (wH < 0){
3017 wComment.sprintf("discrepancy physical block size %ld header block size %ld.",pSB.End - pSB.Begin,pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3018 }
3019 break;
3020 case ZBS_Free:
3021 pSBCount.FreeBlocks ++;
3022 pSBCount.FreeVolume += pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize;
3023 wBlockSize.sprintf("%15ld",pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3024 wH = int (pSB.End - pSB.Begin - pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3025 if (wH > 0) {
3026 wHoleSize.sprintf("%ld",wH);
3027 pSBCount.Holes ++;
3028 pSBCount.HoleVolume += wH;
3029 }
3030 else if (wH < 0){
3031 wComment.sprintf("discrepancy physical block size %ld header block size %ld.",pSB.End - pSB.Begin,pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3032 }
3033 break;
3034 case ZBS_Deleted:
3035 pSBCount.DeletedBlocks ++;
3036 pSBCount.DeletedVolume += pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize;
3037 wBlockSize.sprintf("%15ld",pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3038 wH = int (pSB.End - pSB.Begin - pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3039 if (wH > 0) {
3040 wHoleSize.sprintf("%ld",wH);
3041 pSBCount.Holes ++;
3042 pSBCount.HoleVolume += wH;
3043 }
3044 else if (wH < 0){
3045 wComment.sprintf("discrepancy physical block size %ld header block size %ld.",pSB.End - pSB.Begin,pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3046 }
3047 break;
3048 case ZBS_Invalid:
3049 wBlockSize = "missing header" ;
3050 wHoleSize.sprintf("%ld",pSB.End-pSB.Begin);
3051 pSBCount.ErroredBlocks ++;
3052 pSBCount.ErroredVolume += pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize;
3053 pSBCount.HoleVolume += pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize;
3054 pSBCount.Holes ++;
3055
3056 wBlockSize.sprintf("%15ld",pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3057 wH = int (pSB.End - pSB.Begin - pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3058 if (wH > 0) {
3059 wHoleSize.sprintf("%ld",wH);
3060 pSBCount.Holes ++;
3061 pSBCount.HoleVolume += wH;
3062 }
3063 else if (wH < 0){
3064 wComment.sprintf("discrepancy physical block size %ld header block size %ld.",pSB.End - pSB.Begin,pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3065 }
3066 break;
3067 }// switch
3068
3069
3070 if (pSB.BlockHeader.State== ZBS_Invalid){
3071 wBlockSize = "missing header" ;
3072 wHoleSize.sprintf("%ld",pSB.End-pSB.Begin);
3073 pSBCount.Holes ++;
3074 pSBCount.HoleVolume += pSB.End-pSB.Begin;
3075 pSBCount.ErroredBlocks ++;
3076 }
3077 else {
3078 wBlockSize.sprintf("%15ld",pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3079 int wH = int (pSB.End - pSB.Begin - pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3080 if (wH > 0) {
3081 wHoleSize.sprintf("%ld",wH);
3082 pSBCount.Holes ++;
3083 pSBCount.HoleVolume += wH;
3084 }
3085 else if (wH < 0){
3086 wComment.sprintf("discrepancy physical block size %ld header block size %ld.",pSB.End - pSB.Begin,pSB.BlockHeader.BlockSize);
3087 }
3088// pSBCount.ErroredBlocks ++;
3089 }
3090 wComment = " ";
3091 if (pSB.BlockHeader.State == ZBS_Invalid) {
3092 wComment = "Errored block";
3093 }
3094
3095 wOut.sprintf("%15ld|%15ld|%15s|%15s|%15s|%s\n",
3096 pSB.Begin,
3097 pSB.End,
3098 decode_ZBS(pSB.BlockHeader.State),
3099 wBlockSize.toCChar(),
3100 wHoleSize.toCChar(),
3101 wComment.toCChar());
3102 return wOut;
3103}

3105/*
3106 * <------------ _searchBlockStart--------------------->
3107 *
3108 * <-----------_searchBlockEnd---------------->
3109 *
3110 * block start block end block start
3111 * F9F9F9F9 ...........................FCFCFCFC.........F5F5F5F5,,,,,,>
3112 * +--------------------+
3113 * Block header export
3114 *
3115 * Well formed block content HOLE
3116 *
3117 */
3118ZStatus
3119ZRawVisuMain::surfaceScanRaw(const uriString & pURIContent,FILE*pOutput) {
3120 ZStatus wSt;
3121 ssize_t wPayload=100000;
3122 int wCount=0;
3123
3124 ScanBlockCount wSBCount;
3125 ZDataBuffer wBlockBuffer;
3126// const unsigned char wStartSign [5]={cst_ZFILESTART_BYTE,cst_ZFILESTART_BYTE,cst_ZFILESTART_BYTE,cst_ZFILESTART_BYTE , 0 };
3127
3128// ZBlockHeader_Export wBlockHeaderExp;
3129// ZBlockHeader wBlockHeader;
3130
3131// unsigned char wEndSign [5]={0xFC,0xFC,0xFC,0xFC , 0 };
3132
3133 int wContentFd = open(pURIContent.toCChar(),O_RDONLY);
3134 if (wContentFd < 0) {
3135 ZException.getErrno(errno,
3136 _GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
3137 ZS_ERROPEN,
3138 Severity_Severe,
3139 "Error opening file <%s> ",
3140 pURIContent.toCChar());
3141 return (ZS_ERROPEN);
3142 }
3143
3144 off_t wFSoff = lseek(wContentFd,0,SEEK_END); /* get file total size */
3145 if (wFSoff < 0) {
3146 ZException.getErrno(errno,
3147 _GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
3148 ZS_FILEERROR,
3149 Severity_Severe,
3150 "Error lseek finding end of file <%s>.",
3151 pURIContent.toCChar());
3152 ::close(wContentFd);
3153 return ZS_FILEERROR;
3154 }
3155
3156 fprintf(pOutput,
3157 "\n__________________________Content Data blocks in physical order______________________________________\n");
3158
3159 size_t wFileSize = wFSoff;
3160
3161 if (wFileSize < wPayload) {
3162 wPayload=wFileSize;
3163 }
3164
3165 fprintf(pOutput,
3166 "Begin address |End address | State | Block size | Hole | Comment\n"
3167 "_______________|_______________|_______________|_______________|_______________|____________________\n"
3168 // "%15ld|%15ld|%15ld|%15s|%15ld|%15ld|%s"
3169 );
3170
3171 off_t wOf = lseek(wContentFd,0,SEEK_SET); /* set to beginning of file */
3172 if (wOf< 0) {
3173 ZException.getErrno(errno,
3174 _GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
3175 ZS_FILEERROR,
3176 Severity_Severe,
3177 "Error lseek finding beginning of file <%s>.",
3178 pURIContent.toCChar());
3179 fprintf(pOutput,ZException.last().formatUtf8().toCChar());
3180 return ZS_FILEERROR;
3181 }
3182 uint32_t wStartMark=0;
3183
3184 ScanBlock wSBlock;
3185
3186 wSBlock.Begin=0;
3187
3188 wSt=_searchBlockStart(wContentFd,wSBlock.Begin,wSBlock.End,wBlockBuffer,wPayload,wCount,wFileSize,&wStartMark);
3189 if (wSt!=ZS_FOUND) {
3190 if (wSt==ZS_EOF) {
3191 ZException.setMessage(_GET_FUNCTION_NAME_,
3192 ZS_INVTYPE,
3193 Severity_Error,
3194 "File <%s> has no start block. File appears to be invalid.",
3195 pURIContent.toString());
3196 fprintf(pOutput,ZException.last().formatUtf8().toCChar());
3197 return ZS_INVTYPE;
3198 }
3199 ZException.addToLast(" file <%s>",pURIContent.toString());
3200 fprintf(pOutput,ZException.last().formatUtf8().toCChar());
3201 return wSt;
3202 } // if (wSt!=ZS_FOUND)
3203
3204 wSt=wSBlock.BlockHeader._importConvert(wSBlock.BlockHeader,(ZBlockHeader_Export*)wBlockBuffer.Data);
3205 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
3206 wSBlock.BlockHeader.clear();
3207 wSBlock.BlockHeader.State = ZBS_Invalid;
3208 }
3209 /* search end mark */
3210
3211 // wSBlock.EndBlock=wBlockBuffer.bsearch(&wEndSign,sizeof(cst_ZBLOCKEND),sizeof(cst_ZBLOCKSTART));
3212
3213 fprintf(pOutput,displaytScanBlock(wSBlock,wSBCount).toCChar());
3214
3215
3216 /* up to here, we have got the first start mark for first record of random file */
3217 wSBlock.Begin = wSBlock.End;
3218 wSt=_searchBlockStart(wContentFd,wSBlock.Begin,wSBlock.End,wBlockBuffer,wPayload,wCount,wFileSize,nullptr);
3219
3220 while (wSt==ZS_FOUND) {
3221 wSt=wSBlock.BlockHeader._importConvert(wSBlock.BlockHeader,(ZBlockHeader_Export*)wBlockBuffer.Data);
3222 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
3223 wSBlock.BlockHeader.clear();
3224 wSBlock.BlockHeader.State = ZBS_Invalid;
3225 }
3226 /* search end mark */
3227
3228// wSBlock.EndBlock=wBlockBuffer.bsearch(&wEndSign,sizeof(cst_ZBLOCKEND),sizeof(cst_ZBLOCKSTART));
3229
3230 fprintf(pOutput,displaytScanBlock(wSBlock,wSBCount).toCChar());
3231
3232 wSBlock.Begin = wSBlock.End;
3233 wSt=_searchBlockStart(wContentFd,wSBlock.Begin,wSBlock.End,wBlockBuffer,wPayload,wCount,wFileSize,nullptr);
3234 }// while (wSt==ZS_FOUND)
3235
3236
3237 if (wSt==ZS_EOF){
3238 wSt=wSBlock.BlockHeader._importConvert(wSBlock.BlockHeader,(ZBlockHeader_Export*)wBlockBuffer.Data);
3239 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
3240 wSBlock.BlockHeader.clear();
3241 wSBlock.BlockHeader.State = ZBS_Invalid;
3242 }
3243 /* search end mark */
3244
3245// wSBlock.EndBlock=wBlockBuffer.bsearch(&wEndSign,sizeof(cst_ZBLOCKEND),sizeof(cst_ZBLOCKSTART));
3246
3247 fprintf(pOutput,displaytScanBlock(wSBlock,wSBCount).toCChar());
3248
3249 } // if (wSt==ZS_EOF)
3250 fprintf(pOutput,
3251 "\n____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________\n");
3252
3253 fprintf(pOutput,"\nEnd of scan address %ld\n",wSBlock.End);
3254 fprintf(pOutput,
3255 "Total blocks.........%d\n"
3256 "Used blocks.........%d\n"
3257 "Free blocks.........%d\n"
3258 "Deleted blocks.......%d\n"
3259 "Errored blocks.......%d\n\n"
3260 "Used blocks size.....%d\n"
3261 "Free blocks size.....%d\n"
3262 "Deleted blocks size..%d\n"
3263 "Errored blocks size..%d\n\n"
3264 "Holes ...............%d\n"
3265 "Cumulated hole size..%d\n",
3266
3267 wSBCount.TotalBlocks,
3268 wSBCount.UsedBlocks,
3269 wSBCount.FreeBlocks,
3270 wSBCount.DeletedBlocks,
3271 wSBCount.ErroredBlocks,
3272
3273 wSBCount.UsedVolume,
3274 wSBCount.FreeVolume,
3275 wSBCount.DeletedVolume,
3276 wSBCount.ErroredVolume,
3277
3278 wSBCount.Holes,
3279 wSBCount.HoleVolume);
3280 fprintf(pOutput,
3281 "____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________\n");
3282
3283 ::close(wContentFd);
3284}

3349 return;
3350 case ZAIES_Error:
3351 case ZAIES_Fatal:
3352 GenlogWin->appendTextColor(Qt::red, pMessage);
3353 return;
3354 default:
3355 GenlogWin->appendTextColor(Qt::yellow, pMessage);
3356 return;

3365ZRawVisuMain::exportZMF(QWidget* pParent,zbs::ZRawMasterFile* pRawMasterFile,ZaiErrors* pErrorLog)
3366{
3367 if (pRawMasterFile==nullptr) {
3368 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Data export",Severity_Error,
3369 "Please select a (raw) master file before exporting its data.");
3370 return ZS_FILENOTEXIST;
3371 }
3372
3373 if (pRawMasterFile->getRecordCount()==0) {
3374 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Data export",Severity_Error,
3375 "No record in file. Nothing to export.");
3376 return ZS_EMPTY;
3377 }
3378
3379 QString wDir;
3380 wDir = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(pParent,"Export content",GeneralParameters.getWorkDirectory().toCChar(),"Xml files (*.xml);;All (*.*)");
3381 if (wDir.isEmpty())
3382 return ZS_EMPTY ;
3383 uriString wURIExport=wDir.toUtf8().data();
3384
3385 /* export progress window setup */
3386
3387 ZMFProgressMWn* ProgressMWn = new ZMFProgressMWn("Data export",pParent,false);
3388
3389 /*
3390 ProgressMWn->setDescBudy("Export to file");
3391 ProgressMWn->setDescText(wURIExport);
3392 ProgressMWn->setProcessDescription("Records processed");
3393 */
3394 ProgressMWn->labelsSetup("Export to file",wURIExport,"Records processed");
3395
3396 ProgressMWn->advanceSetupCallBack(pRawMasterFile->getRecordCount(),"Export to file");
3397

3705ZRawVisuMain::importZMF(QWidget* pParent, ZaiErrors *pErrorLog)
3706{
3707 uriString wDir = GeneralParameters.getWorkDirectory();
3708 uriString wZMFURI;
3709 ZRawMasterFile *wZMF=nullptr;
3710 zmode_type wOpenMode=0;
3711 ZStatus wSt=ZS_SUCCESS;
3712
3713 QString wFileName = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(pParent, tr("Target import raw master file"),
3714 wDir.toCChar(),
3715 "master files (*.zmf);;All (*.*)");
3716 if (wFileName.isEmpty())
3717 return ZS_EMPTY ;
3718 wZMFURI= wFileName.toUtf8().data();
3719 if (!wZMFURI.exists()) {
3720
3721 return ZS_FILENOTEXIST;
3722 }
3723 wZMF = new ZRawMasterFile;
3724
3725 wSt=wZMF->zopen(wZMFURI,ZRF_All);
3726
3727 if (wZMF->getRecordCount() > 0) {
3728 int wRet=ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage2B("Import raw master file",Severity_Question,"Quit","Do it",nullptr,nullptr,
3729 "Processing %s\n"
3730 "Master file has already %ld record(s).\n"
3731 "Populating this file with imported data may cause key collisions and/or incompatibility.\n"
3732 "Do you want to import data ?\n"
3733 "Import anyway <Do it>\n"
3734 "Quit without doing anything <Quit>\n",
3735 wZMFURI.toString(),
3736 wZMF->getRecordCount());
3737 if (wRet==QDialog::Rejected)
3738 return ZS_FILEERROR ;
3739 }
3740 // wZMF->zclose();
3741
3742
3743 wFileName = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(pParent,"Source import xml content",wDir.toCChar(),"Xml files (*.xml);;All (*.*)");
3744 if (wFileName.isEmpty())
3745 return ZS_EMPTY ;
3746 uriString wURIContentImport=wFileName.toUtf8().data();
3747
3748 /* export progress window setup */
3749
3750 ZMFProgressMWn* ProgressMWn = new ZMFProgressMWn("Data import",pParent,false);
3751
3752 /*
3753 ProgressMWn->setDescBudy("Export to file");
3754 ProgressMWn->setDescText(wURIExport);
3755 ProgressMWn->setProcessDescription("Records processed");
3756 */
3757 ProgressMWn->labelsSetup("Export to file",wURIContentImport,"Bytes of text processed");
3758
3759 ProgressMWn->advanceSetupCallBack(wZMF->getRecordCount(),"Import to file");
3760
3761 ProgressMWn->show();
3762
3763 wZMF->registerProgressSetupCallBack(std::bind(&ZMFProgressMWn::advanceSetupCallBack, ProgressMWn,std::placeholders::_1,std::placeholders::_2));
3764 wZMF->registerProgressCallBack(std::bind(&ZMFProgressMWn::advanceCallBack, ProgressMWn,std::placeholders::_1,std::placeholders::_2));
3765
3766 wSt=wZMF->XmlImportContentByChunk(wURIContentImport,ZEXOP_CheckName | ZEXOP_CheckZType, pErrorLog);
3767
3768 ProgressMWn->setDone(wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS);
3769
3770 if (wSt!=ZS_SUCCESS) {
3771 if (pErrorLog==nullptr)
3772 fprintf(stderr,"Data import: Something went wrong status <%s> while importing data from <%s>",
3773 decode_ZStatus(wSt),
3774 wZMF->getURIContent().getBasename().toCChar());
3775 else
3776 pErrorLog->errorLog("Data import: Something went wrong status <%s> while importing data from <%s>",
3777 decode_ZStatus(wSt),
3778 wZMF->getURIContent().getBasename().toCChar());
3779 utf8VaryingString wMsg = ZException.formatFullUserMessage();
3780 ZExceptionDLg::adhocMessage("Data import",Severity_Error,pErrorLog,&wMsg,"Data export: Something went wrong status <%s> while importing data from <%s>",
3781 decode_ZStatus(wSt),
3782 wZMF->getURIContent().getBasename().toCChar());
3783 }
3784
3785 wZMF->zclose();
3786 delete wZMF;
3787 return wSt;
3788} // ZRawVisuMain::importZMF
